prompt_en: A complex photograph portrays a human subject in a visible posed state during a quiet dawn ballet rehearsal in a botanical conservatory. The subject is a visibly adult woman, with visible face-and-hair appearance guided by the supplied portrait: a chin-length dark bob, lightly separated center bangs, defined brows, dark eyes, and softly pink lips. Her composed gaze meets the camera; her calm presence and the soft scoop neckline of an ivory long-sleeved ballet leotard lend subtle intimate appeal. A short charcoal practice skirt skims the upper thighs, leaving both knees clearly visible; pale soft ballet slippers show their heel and forefoot contours. She holds ballet second position: her feet spread laterally a little wider than her hips across one level dry wooden platform, toes pointing outward in opposite directions. Her two legs turn outward, so each knee faces the same direction as its matching toes. Each pale slipper makes its own uncrossed footprint, the entire sole, heel and forefoot flat against the wood with a narrow contact shadow. In that same base she holds a shallow demi-plié, bending both knees outward over their toes while her pelvis lowers between her legs and her torso stays upright. Her fifth-position arms, bras en couronne, form one softly rounded oval above her head; both elbows remain softly bent, her fingertips stop apart with a small air gap, and her shoulders remain low. Her two empty hands belong to those raised arms. A low stool stands well behind the dance space, holding a closed violin case beside an open notebook of annotated music; fern fronds and condensation on the glass frame the rehearsal bay. Cool blue dawn window light outlines the leaves while a small warm practical lamp brings gentle light to her face and ivory fabric. Photograph her from waist height at a slight frontal three-quarter offset, in a vertical full-length frame that includes the entire overhead arm oval, both knees, both feet and the floor contacts. Crisp subject detail and restrained background depth keep the rounded arms, bent knees and grounded outward feet legible together.
